data.narrative:
Lydian is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Branko Zugic and Joe Rodden that has raised $62.1M to date. The climate and energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, though the private peer set spans heterogeneous stages and valuations, limiting direct comparability.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method given data constraints. Using total raised ($62.1M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next financing stage yields $124M. This reflects the incremental value creation expected between Series A and subsequent rounds, though it does not anchor to revenue, growth rates, or sector-specific metrics. The peer-median method was not applicable; while eight climate and energy peers exist, no subset of three or more companies matched both stage and valuation tier, making a narrowly-filtered median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $106M (low) to $143M (median $124M), centered on the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or unit economics data, limited comparability within the climate and energy sector at Series A, and reliance on a single methodological approach. A more granular valuation would require either revenue multiples or a denser peer set at comparable stages.
